confidence_notes: Restaurant meals, coffee and beer are anchored on Numbeo-derived figures for La Spezia (Expatica, June 2026): inexpensive meal about €15.6, three-course meal for two about €78, cappuccino about €1.63, 0.5 L domestic draught about €5.2. Other aggregators were similar. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass had no direct La Spezia data. I set them from the local beer price and Italy-wide aperitivo and house-wine ranges (cocktail about €8–9, glass of wine about €5). Euro figures were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which I did not search for. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for July peak season. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings, so they are the least certain. La Spezia has few hostels, and hotel prices vary a lot with Cinque Terre demand. The FX figure is the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 observation as shown in a search result.
comparable_city_reasoning: La Spezia is a mid-sized Ligurian port city and the base for Cinque Terre visits. Food prices sit near Italian provincial norms and slightly above the national average. Summer accommodation is lifted by Cinque Terre spillover demand, in a way comparable to other Italian Riviera gateway towns.
